comparisons.peer_topic: Income Tax Provision and Effective Rate
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD recorded an income tax provision of $381 million in 2024 with a 19% effective tax rate, compared to a $346 million benefit and (68%) rate in 2023. The 2024 provision increase was driven by higher pre-tax income and a $373 million tax effect from an intercompany integration transaction.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose specific discrete tax events impacting their fiscal 2024 results, but they differ in nature and impact. NVDA reports a specific $145 million non-cash net benefit resulting from the resolution of an IRS audit for fiscal years 2018 and 2019, which served as a positive adjustment to its tax provision. In contrast, AMD reports a total income tax provision of $381 million driven by higher pre-tax income and a $373 million tax effect from an intercompany integration transaction, with no mention of a discrete audit resolution benefit comparable to NVDA's; AMD's 2024 effective tax rate was 19%, whereas NVDA's specific audit resolution is a discrete item offsetting other factors.

sentences.text: We recognized a non-cash net benefit of $145 million, related to this IRS audit resolution, for effectively settled positions.
We recorded an income tax provision of $381 million in 2024 and an income tax benefit of $346 million in 2023, representing effective tax rates of 19% and (68%), respectively.
The increase in income tax provision in 2024 was primarily due to higher pre-tax income and a $373 million tax effect from an intercompany integration transaction.
